MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Ride Out feels like a natural next choice because Bob Seger's rootsy rock connects with the blues and guitar-led music I have recently chosen.",
    "If Wrecking Ball is the Bruce Springsteen album, its roots rock fits my current interests; classic Motown soul also appeals, though Ride Out would get my limited listening time first."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Christmas albums miss my current mood because I am looking for blues and roots rock, with no recent indication that I want seasonal music.",
    "Vocal duets, polished vocal pop, and contemporary funk-pop do not offer the guitar-led sound I want right now.",
    "I cannot confidently choose The United Artists Collection without knowing the artist, because the title alone does not establish a connection to my interests."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The choices seem to treat broadly familiar music as interchangeable, even though roots rock and polished vocal pop serve different listening moods for me.",
    "The holiday selections suggest that a loose connection to familiar performers mattered more than whether I currently want Christmas music."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent choices, including Old Sock and People, Hell & Angels, point toward blues, expressive guitar playing, and roots-oriented rock.",
    "I rarely choose something unless the connection feels clear, so a broadly appealing album is less compelling than one that directly fits my current listening mood."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in roots rock but stretched it too broadly into seasonal music and vocal pop."
}
